kind: prospective Criterion-coverage and symbol-demangling amendment; fixtures, resources, sampling, the Inferno collapse and flame graph settings, iteration counts, every existing Criterion case and every existing acceptance rule are unchanged; the demangled copies add a conservation rule
cause: Two indra-engine Criterion benches were never built into the profile export, so neither produced a measurement under the one- and two-CPU limits. benches/language_model.rs times the pure-Rust Indra OCR 1.1 additions: n-gram log-probability lookups, the LM beam search that the default recognition path runs, and the bidi flip. benches/continuous.rs times serial versus continuous batch selection for the opt-in continuous-batching pilot. Separately, the flame graphs and perf reports of that run showed Rust v0 symbols in mangled form, for example _RNvMs0_NtCsjXFQbJxCqLY_12indra_engine7runtimeNtB5_6Engine9recognize for <indra_engine::runtime::Engine>::recognize.

observed_gap.observation: criterion-results.jsonl holds the 46 declared cases at each CPU cap, all from the postprocessing, control_path, verification and propagation benches; no lm_logp, beam_search, rtl_flip or continuous_selection case exists

changed_protocol_fields.reason: Paired Criterion arms of the vectorised skew row sum (engine commit "perf(engine): sum skew thumbnail rows in vectorised u32 blocks"): the checked i64 legacy loop and the u32 block sum on the fine and coarse skew thumbnails of the math (564x800, 282x400) and TIFF (800x160, 400x80) fixtures; each bench asserts bit-equal sums before measuring

changed_protocol_fields.to: rustfilt 0.2.2; see the protocol for its application and admission

execution_changes: docker/native.Dockerfile builds the language_model and continuous benches into the engine-profile-export bundle and checks them for static linkage
scripts/profile-native.sh runs both benches in the Criterion phase, requires them in the bundle and takes the expected case count from criterion.expected_total_cases
scripts/admit-native-profile.py derives the case set from the protocol and requires its length to equal criterion.expected_total_cases
docker/profile-tools.Dockerfile installs rustfilt 0.2.2 with cargo install --locked and binds its binary hash into the tool identities
scripts/profile-native.sh draws each flame graph from the demangled folded stacks and writes a demangled report next to the raw one
scripts/verify-native-profile-samples.sh and scripts/admit-native-profile.py admit the demangled files only when they conserve the raw stacks, weights and unmangled report lines
phase_budget: Run 39839055833 finished the 46-case Criterion phase in 210 s at each CPU cap. At the same cost per case the 85 cases need about 390 s, inside the unchanged 900 s phase limit.

resources and CPU budgets, including the 900 s phase limit
